headline: Serasa says Black Friday debt renegotiation will compete with shopping
summary: A Serasa survey indicates that 36% of Brazilian consumers plan to use Black Friday to renegotiate debts and balance their budgets for 2027, while 33% admit difficulty following their planned budget.
why: Consumer debt renegotiation trends around major retail events provide insight into household leverage, default risks, and retail sector revenue distribution.

impacts.name: Brazilian Retail Sector
impacts.why: Consumer focus on debt reduction may temper discretionary retail spending during promotional sales.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
